highlights.title: V-FiLLM: Verified Financial LLM Reasoning Benchmark
highlights.summary: V-FiLLM: a financial reasoning benchmark framework
highlights.detail: V-FiLLM generates benchmarks from executable computation trees, allowing for arbitrary scale without annotation cost. It exposes four axes of difficulty, including computation depth and financial concept complexity.

highlights.title: ReRound: Reconstructive Rounding to Resolve Midpoint Ambiguity in Calibration-Free LLM Quantization
highlights.detail: ReRound addresses midpoint ambiguity in standard round-to-nearest schemes by training a conditional diffusion model to produce continuous reconstructions of low-bit weights.

highlights.title: Mapping and Measuring the Behavioral Evolution of Large Language Models
highlights.summary: Behavioral evolution of large language models studied
highlights.detail: The study characterizes output behavior using sentence-level dissimilarities and constructs behavioral maps to analyze static organization and temporal change across model generations.

highlights.title: Apple Silicon and macOS VMs: Faster LLM Inference with llama.cpp
highlights.summary: Faster LLM inference with llama.cpp on Apple Silicon
highlights.detail: The use of llama.cpp on Apple Silicon and macOS VMs enables faster LLM inference.

highlights.summary: Stealing reasoning traces from proprietary LLM APIs
